caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a lid. The front and visible side of the chest are painted in a muted reddish-brown color, decorated with repeating geometric and stylized floral or sunburst motifs in white and dark blue-green shades. The motifs are arranged in horizontal rows; the upper row features blue-green U-shaped designs, followed by alternating circular and asterisk-like symbols, also in blue-green and white. The lower section of the chest showcases diamond-shaped patterns extending toward the base. There is a keyhole located at the center of the front, above a large central blue-green and black motif resembling a tulip or stylized plant. The chest has a broad, dark-colored base and slightly protruding edges, suggesting sturdy construction. Shadows underneath indicate the chest is placed on a flat surface.
title: Decorated Box
